mainEntity.name: Should I install window casing myself or hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY can work if the opening is simple and you already have the tools and finishing skills, but professional installation is a better fit for out-of-square openings, older homes, or matched trim work. A pro is also useful if you want the casing to blend with existing baseboards, door trim, or a specific style. For homes in Denver and the surrounding suburbs, hiring help is often the safer choice when you want a clean finish on the first try.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for simple openings, but a pro is better for uneven walls, older homes, or a cleaner finish. If you want matching trim and tight corners, professional installation is usually worth it.
